preconditions: Current trusted runtime and real CLI/request/registry consumers; explicit process-local ledgers and clearly named counter fixtures for exact arithmetic.
steps: Run real environment commands with and without --metrics, including explicit selected-project error outcomes.
Reuse one owned ledger across completed windows and compare independent CPU/wall sums, RSS peaks and registered byte peaks.
Check machine values, measurement sources, unchanged semantic payloads and project inventories.

oracle.requirement_contract: SpecRoad MUSS verbrauchte CPU-Zeit und verstrichene Zeit als getrennte betriebliche Größen nach Anhang O.2 behandeln.
oracle.scope: Real CLI, structured and registry consumers expose separate process CPU and monotonic wall intervals. Explicit arithmetic fixtures check their distinct cumulative totals and omit gaps between invocation windows. Native sources are read without an external monitor.

open_items: Partial 6.d.W scope: parsed-command preparation through result assembly and explicit embedded windows only. Interpreter bootstrap/earlier parsing, final delivery, child processes, all-phase subtotals, periodic checkpoints, durable Work identity/resume, other RSS platform adapters and complete runtime/platform performance acceptance remain open. Native RSS is a current-process lifetime peak, not exclusive per-work memory or host capacity. Exact arithmetic fixtures are not benchmarks.
